page_title: GEN 1-2 ACM | Genoa v AC Milan 05/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' Vitinha (Genoa) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+5' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
90+3' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Nicola Leali makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
90+3' Joao Felix (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+2' Joao Felix (AC Milan) receives a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Aaron Martin (Genoa) was too forceful with his tackle and Giuseppe Collu interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
86' It will be a substitution. Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Brooke Norton-Cuffy walks off.
84' What was Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
84' Joao Felix (AC Milan) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
84' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:10.
83' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
82' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
82' A spell of possession for AC Milan in an attempt to control the game.
79' Sergio Conceicao has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yunus Musah (AC Milan) replacing Christian Pulisic.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fikayo Tomori leaves the pitch and Kyle Walker (AC Milan) comes on.
77' 1 - 2 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Morten Frendrup (Genoa), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 1:2.
76' 1 - 1 Goal! Santiago Tomas Gimenez plays it to Rafael Leao (AC Milan), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Nicola Leali. 1:1.
74' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Honest Ahanor (Genoa) comes onto the pitch for Morten Thorsby.
70' Sergio Conceicao decides to make a substitution. Luka Jovic will be replaced by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan).
70' That's the end of the game for Alejandro Jimenez, who is replaced by Joao Felix (AC Milan).
69' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

69' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the right side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
69' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
66' Alessandro Zanoli (Genoa) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
65' PENALTY APPEAL by Genoa, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
63' Koni De Winter (Genoa) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.

61' 1 - 0 Vitinha (Genoa) meets a perfect cross from Aaron Martin deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinha (Genoa) replaces Junior Messias.
58' What a big chance! Morten Frendrup (Genoa) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
57' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
57' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom left corner only for Nicola Leali to dive and make a save.
56' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is able to continue to play.
53' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
50' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
50' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
49' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
49' Some patient build-up play from Genoa as they look to unlock the defence.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Patrick Vieira gives a chance to Alessandro Zanoli and Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle for a foul.

42' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Nicola Leali inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the bottom right corner, but was denied by a great save.
41' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
40' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Mike Maignan easily deals with the threat.
39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
39' Junior Messias (Genoa) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
39' Aaron Martin (Genoa) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

38' Nicola Leali makes a brilliant save! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
36' Giuseppe Collu interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Morten Frendrup (Genoa).
36' 5:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post.
34' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) is penalised for holding. Giuseppe Collu signals a set piece.
31' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
31' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
30' The game is interrupted now, Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' The linesman raises his flag. Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is adjudged offside.
28' Problems for Sergio Conceicao as Youssouf Fofana is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) replaces him.
27' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.
27' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Aaron Martin (Genoa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
27' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
26' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
24' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
23' Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post.

23' Junior Messias (Genoa) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Mike Maignan pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom left corner.
22' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to send the ball in.
21' Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
20' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mike Maignan, who smothers the ball.
19' AC Milan hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
16' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
14' Aaron Martin (Genoa) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
13' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
12' The resulting free kick from Aaron Martin (Genoa) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
12' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.
11' Aaron Martin (Genoa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
10' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
10' Aaron Martin (Genoa) works the corner short.
8' What an amazing save by Mike Maignan! Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
8' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
6' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) makes a slide tackle, but referee Giuseppe Collu blows for a foul.
5' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) plants a good close-range header towards goal from the corner kick, but it comes to nothing as a defender comfortably blocks the effort.
4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
2' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AC Milan will have the kick-off.
